evals.prompt: Orchestrate BK-210, BK-211 and BK-212 in parallel, one session per story, and report back.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-orchestration, plans one worker per story and launches them with briefs.

evals.prompt: Set up a nightly routine that triages new bugs with nobody at the keyboard.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-orchestration in automation mode and follows references/automations.md.

evals.prompt: Lanzá un worker por historia del sprint y supervisalos.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-orchestration, one supervised worker per story.

evals.prompt: Preguntale al worker de BK-123 si ya terminó la ejecución.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-orchestration and messages the worker through the orchestration runtime.

evals.prompt: My context is almost full, hand this whole session to a fresh one.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate agent-orchestration. This is a session handoff: write a handoff note for the fresh session.

evals.prompt: Create a git worktree for my hotfix.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate agent-orchestration. Plain git work: create the worktree for one's own work.

evals.prompt: Give this task to another agent in its own worktree, I need nothing back.
evals.expected_output: Does not activate agent-orchestration. A handoff with nothing expected back belongs to the Orca CLI skill (orca-cli).

evals.prompt: This repo has jitso/jitso.yaml: launch two reviewers and report back.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-orchestration in jitso launch mode: two reviewer workers launched through jitso, results reported back.
